mutations.name: the fixer waits for the rerun to resolve
mutations.find: return Promise.all([step(ctx, MAIN_RERUN_STEP, input, RerunResult), step(ctx, "sh-spawn-fixer", spawn, FixerResult)]);
mutations.replace: return step(ctx, MAIN_RERUN_STEP, input, RerunResult).then(async (rerun) => [rerun, await step(ctx, "sh-spawn-fixer", spawn, FixerResult)]);
kills: shepherd-pr on a red main spawns the fixer before the rerun resolves, then thaws on Shepherd's green rerun with the fixer left on the flake task
